ensure_api_key() {
  if [[ -n ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY:-} || -n ${OPENROUTER_BASE_URL:-} ]]; then
    warn "OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL are ignored. Use SHY_API_KEY, or OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY."
  fi
  if [[ -n ${OPENAI_BASE_URL:-} ]]; then
    LLM_URL=${OPENAI_BASE_URL%/}
    case $LLM_URL in
      *openrouter.ai*) LLM_PROVIDER=openrouter ;;
      *) LLM_PROVIDER=openai ;;
    esac
    if [[ -z ${OPENAI_API_KEY:-} ]]; then
      [[ -n $HAVE_TTY ]] || die "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set and there is no terminal to ask for it."
      printf '%sOpenAI API key%s (input hidden): ' "$C_BOLD" "$C_RST" >/dev/tty
      IFS= read -r -s OPENAI_API_KEY </dev/tty
      printf '\n' >/dev/tty
      OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY//[[:space:]]/}
      [[ -n $OPENAI_API_KEY ]] || die "no API key given."
      note "Tip: export OPENAI_API_KEY to skip this prompt."
    fi
    LLM_KEY=$OPENAI_API_KEY
    return 0
  fi
  local base=${SHY_BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8080}
  LLM_URL=${base%/}/v1
  LLM_PROVIDER=shyd
  if [[ -z ${SHY_API_KEY:-} ]]; then
    [[ -n $HAVE_TTY ]] || die "SHY_API_KEY is not set and there is no terminal to ask for it."
    printf '%sshy API key%s (input hidden): ' "$C_BOLD" "$C_RST" >/dev/tty
    IFS= read -r -s SHY_API_KEY </dev/tty
    printf '\n' >/dev/tty
    SHY_API_KEY=${SHY_API_KEY//[[:space:]]/}
    [[ -n $SHY_API_KEY ]] || die "no API key given."
    note "Tip: export SHY_API_KEY to skip this prompt."
  fi
  LLM_KEY=$SHY_API_KEY
}

content.text:
`shyd` now proxies chat completions, and `shy.sh` sends model calls there by default.

**shyd** accepts `POST /v1/chat/completions` only with an install key, then forwards the body to OpenRouter using the server's own key. Set `SHY_OPENAI_API_KEY` to that OpenRouter key. `SHY_OPENAI_BASE_URL` defaults to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`, so you can point the same proxy at another OpenAI-compatible root. With no upstream key, model calls return 503 and traces keep working.

**shy.sh** uses `SHY_API_KEY` (the install key) and `SHY_BASE_URL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8080`). To skip shyd, set `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` instead. `OPENAI_BASE_URL` is the API root, including `/v1`. `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` are ignored.

A new install on the dashboard now shows:

```bash
export SHY_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080
export SHY_API_KEY=shy_...
export NEATLOGS_INGEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080
export NEATLOGS_API_KEY=shy_...
```

Traces with no key are still stored as anonymous. Model calls with no key are rejected. I checked a full call from `shy.sh` through shyd: the upstream saw the server key, not the install key, and the dashboard last-seen time updated.
